author: CNET
description:
Did someone order a new Kindle design? How about five Kindle designs?

Amazon showed off the newest version of Kindle, including a pocket-worthy 6-in model with 16GB of storage and up to six weeks of battery life, starting at $149.

The new $199 Kindle Paperwhite is lighter and thinner with 12 weeks of battery life and its largest display yet.

The $289.99 Kindle Colorsoft features “paper-like color” without normal tablet glare through its nitride LEDs and micro-deflectors.

All of the new models now have front-flush displays and if you’re feeling fancy you can pay to upgrade to the signature version of each with an aluminum back.

CNET Executive Editor David Carnoy is here to breakdown what you need to know about these new Kindles.
